meta.name: Lord of Mysteries
meta.description: In a Victorian world of steam, dreadnoughts, and occult horrors, Zhou Mingrui awakens as Klein Moretti. He walks a razor’s edge between light and darkness, entangled with warring Churches. This is the legend of unlimited potential…and unspeakable danger.

videos.title: The Fool
videos.overview: Zhou Mingrui wakes up in the body of Klein Moretti. A strange notebook holds the key to a dark power.

videos.title: Beyonder
videos.overview: Klein Moretti joins the Nighthawks and heads off on his first task to find an abducted child.

videos.title: The Notebook
videos.overview: Klein Moretti pursues the Antigonus Family's notebook and faces off against another Beyonder.

videos.title: Magic Mirror
videos.overview: Klein Moretti learns ritualistic magic from Old Neil. Meanwhile, an organization has their eyes on Klein.

videos.title: Hero
videos.overview: A tragedy befalls a passenger ship and Klein Moretti is tasked with solving the mystery.

videos.title: Teacher
videos.overview: Klein Moretti discovers an ancient secret about his teacher, Azik Eggers.

videos.title: Coincidence
videos.overview: When too many coincidences appear, Klein Moretti discovers he may be caught in an elaborate scheme.

videos.title: Losing Control
videos.overview: Klein Moretti is on a mission, and the most dreaded fate that could happen to a Beyonder becomes reality.

videos.title: Party
videos.overview: Klein succeeds in ascending to Sequence 8, but this glorious moment is overshadowed by an event.

videos.title: Clue
videos.overview: Dunn and Klein attend the scene of a possibly supernatural murder of a congressman.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.overview: Following Klein's suspicions, the Nighthawk investigates what Sharon Khoy is hiding.

videos.title: The Bomb
videos.overview: Lanevus threatens to destroy Tingen, putting the Nighthawks in check.

videos.title: Light
videos.overview: The Nighthawks defend Tingen from evil's descent, and past events are revealed to be more than coincidences.

meta.slogan: Awaken from the mysteries, praise the fool's legend!
